2025-06-13T01:37:48.5538187Z <pr_title>
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5538549Z Add Prefect 3.3.4 build configuration for OT-2 robot
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5539032Z </pr_title>
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5539205Z 
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5539330Z <pr_description>
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5540588Z This PR implements a complete build configuration to compile and package Prefect 3.3.4 for the Opentrons OT-2 robot, addressing the community request for workflow orchestration capabilities on OT-2 systems.
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5541648Z 
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5541742Z ## What's Added
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5541869Z 
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5542185Z - **Package Structure**: Created `packages/prefect/3.3.4/` directory following repository conventions
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5543112Z - **Build Configuration**: Implemented `build.py` that:
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5543822Z   - Downloads Prefect 3.3.4 source code from the official PrefectHQ/prefect GitHub repository
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5544623Z   - Configures cross-compilation for arm7hf architecture (OT-2 compatible)
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5545416Z   - Uses `bdist_wheel` build command appropriate for Python packages
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5546308Z - **Documentation**: Added comprehensive `README.md` explaining build process, dependencies, and usage
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5546960Z 
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5547112Z ## Technical Implementation
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5547337Z 
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5547678Z The build configuration uses the existing build system infrastructure:
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5548179Z 
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5548312Z ```python
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5548644Z from builder import package_build
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5548929Z 
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5549105Z package_build.build_package(
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5549935Z     source=package_build.github_source(
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5550381Z         org='PrefectHQ',
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5550706Z         repo='prefect',
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5551017Z         tag='3.3.4'),
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5551342Z     setup_py_commands=['bdist_wheel'],
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5551618Z     build_dependencies=[]
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5551824Z )
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5551982Z ```
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5552076Z 
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5552157Z ## Dependencies Handled
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5552294Z 
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5552592Z Prefect includes several runtime dependencies with native components that will be automatically resolved:
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5553367Z - `cryptography` - Cryptographic library with native code
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5553718Z - `asyncpg` - PostgreSQL adapter with C extensions  
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5554037Z - `orjson` - Fast JSON library with Rust extensions
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5554403Z - `pydantic-core` - Pydantic validation core with Rust extensions
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5554738Z - `ujson` - Fast JSON library with C extensions
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5555042Z - `websockets` - WebSocket library with C extensions
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5555241Z 
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5555310Z ## Validation
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5555415Z 
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5555504Z All validation tests pass:
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5556003Z - ✅ Package discovery correctly identifies Prefect package
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5556382Z - ✅ Build configuration syntax and imports validated
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5556701Z - ✅ Documentation complete and accurate
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5557020Z - ✅ Integration with existing build system confirmed
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5557210Z 
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5557282Z ## Usage
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5557376Z 
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5557514Z Once this PR is merged, users can build Prefect for OT-2:
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5557723Z 
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5557789Z ```bash
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5558204Z ./build-packages --verbose --build-type packages-only
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5558473Z ```
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5558564Z 
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5558649Z And install it on OT-2 robots:
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5558802Z 
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5558866Z ```bash
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5559119Z pip install prefect --index-url <opentrons-package-index-url>
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5559423Z ```
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5559508Z 
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5559960Z This enables autonomous experimental workflows with Prefect orchestration directly on OT-2 robots, eliminating the need for external orchestration devices.
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5560480Z 
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5560550Z Fixes #1.
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5560645Z

2025-06-13T01:37:48.5584551Z

2025-06-13T01:37:48.5596513Z I've updated the installation instructions to provide easier options using curl and pip directly. The new approach:
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5596917Z

2025-06-13T01:37:48.5597872Z 2. **Updated README with simplified instructions** using direct curl download from GitHub releases:
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5598276Z    ```bash
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5598876Z    curl -L https://github.com/sgbaird/opentrons-python-packages/releases/download/[RELEASE_TAG]/prefect-3.3.4-py3-none-any.whl -o /tmp/prefect-3.3.4-py3-none-any.whl
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5599564Z    pip install /tmp/prefect-3.3.4-py3-none-any.whl
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5599819Z    ```
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5600152Z 3. **Eliminated the need for SCP/FTP** - now just requires curl and pip which should be available on OT-2
2025-06-13T01:37:48.5600489Z
